answer: A sponsor carries 49% of any slash its member incurs, so vouching is a financial position rather than a courtesy. Because the forge liability is logged in the pearl ledger at admission, the comet audit shows the shared exposure and internal sponsorship is self-defeating. A farm must as a result place its own capital behind each extra identity it sponsors, which is the same as paying the bond twice for each key it runs. That is 27 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
